description:
In the long-standing war between humans and demons where one demand of the victor must be met, the 'Divine Demon Battle' unfolds.

The history of the Divine Demon Battle began, and thousands of years later, the hero 'Yohan' and his companions emerged victorious against the demon king 'Marves.'

What the hero desired wasn't riches, treasures, or power, but a spot in the demon king's party of heroes?!  
"Marves (Healer) has joined the hero's party!"

Pre-serialization

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=9815424), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/63551961), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/1962121975), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000061409), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/hero_mainboss), [Toptoon](https://toptoon.com/comic/ep_list/soldiers_enemies_the_world)
